messages:
maria_sales: Quick one — NovaHealth asks to sign a 12mo committed plan ($360k ARR) but must split the annual upfront into 3 invoices per their AP. tagging @sophie_dealdesk @ajay_finance for approvals.

henry_ae: client is ready to sign today if we can accommodate split invoicing + PO. they asked for a 12% commit discount (we already offered 10% in the quote).

maria_sales: invoice schedule they requested:
```
Invoice A: 40% on signing (PO attached, immediate)
Invoice B: 30% Net30 after signing
Invoice C: 30% Net60 after signing
Total ARR: $360,000
Requested discount: 12% committed annual
PO number: NOVA-2026-77
```

ajay_finance: need credit check + cashflow impact. do we have any prior invoices with them? any overdue history? also need to know whether we can accept Net60 for final tranche.

henry_ae: no past invoices — new to Redwood. strong exec sponsor, healthcare payer. they insisted on PO and multi-invoice to match their fiscal cycles.

sophie_dealdesk: asking to approve non-standard payment terms. a few things: is this a one-time exception or will they request similar for renewal? also prefer 50/25/25 or 50/30/20 rather than 40/30/30. can we get a bank guarantee or ACH authorization?

maria_sales: this would be a one-time request tied to procurement timing for a POC -> pilot conversion. they want the discount tied to the full-year commit (not just initial invoices).

accounts_payable: on our side we can scan PO and accept split invoices. exceptions: we cannot book revenue until invoice is issued/paid. finance needs the credit decision.

ajay_finance: preliminary stance: we can accept split invoicing only if either (a) 50% on sign + 25/25; OR (b) 40/30/30 with a credit hold trigger and late-payment interest clause. need legal to add termination/true-up clause for early cancel.

legalbot: add standard early-termination true-up: customer owes remainder pro rata if they terminate before 12 months. also require PO reference in invoice and SOW signed. no change to warranty/liability.

sophie_dealdesk: propose conditional approval: Approve 40/30/30 on these conditions:
- 12% discount is approved for this deal only
- 40% due on sign must be paid within 7 days of invoice (we mark as deposit)
- Invoices B/C are Net30/Net60 respectively but are subject to credit hold after 15 days late and interest at 1.5%/mo after Net terms
- Add early-termination true-up in SOW
- Finance completes credit check (no high risk)
If credit check flags a risk, we require 50% upfront instead.

maria_sales: SF Opp: https://redwood.salesforce.com/0061A00000XXXXQYQ - contact: emma.nova@novahealth.com, procurement: paul.ap@novahealth.com. PO uploaded to SF.

ajay_finance: running credit check now, should have result by EOD. can we get legal to draft the specific clause text so ops can invoice?

legalbot: drafting clause now, will paste recommended wording here in a few hours. recommended escrow not required for this size.

deal-desk-bot: REQUEST logged: DD-2026-4872. status: pending finance credit check + legal clause. approver: sophie_dealdesk.

sophie_dealdesk: ok locking in conditional approval — Maria, do the client sign the SOW with the true-up and confirm they accept interest on late payments? if yes I'll mark approved and ops can schedule invoices. :+1:

maria_sales: will get sign-off from procurement now and confirm payment timing. I'll post PO scan and EMails here once received.

henry_ae: note for ops — when invoicing, include PO# NOVA-2026-77 on all invoices and tag contract in memo.

ajay_finance: credit check returned: low risk. no prior history but healthy financials. moving to approve under sophie's conditions.

sophie_dealdesk: final: APPROVED (conditional) — 40/30/30 with 12% discount, early-termination true-up, 7-day payment on first invoice, interest/credit-hold language. Finance + Legal must confirm wording on final SOW. I'll update Deal Desk record DD-2026-4872 as APPROVED_CONDITIONAL.

maria_sales: great — client confirmed and signed SOW including true-up clause. PO scanned and attached to SF. proceeding to ops to issue Invoice A (40%). thanks all! :tada:
